task.name: prep leftovers for reheating

declared_intent.text: Lid off the clips but resting loose so it doesn't splatter.

task.outcome_evidence: All four latches are released, steam vent is open, and lid is resting loosely over the bowl.

narration.text: I'm prepping these leftover rice and dal for the microwave. I want the lid off the clips but resting loose so it doesn't splatter.
Unclipping the first latch, second, and third one.
Wait, this fourth latch is really stuck.
Pressing down on the lid to take tension off the clip... there, popped it open.
A sealed lid warps in the microwave, so we leave it resting loose.

actions.observed_action: Unclips latches 1, 2, and 3 around the rim.
actions.instruction: Unclip latches 1, 2, and 3 on the container.
actions.visual_evidence: Both hands disengage latches 1, 2, and 3 in sequence with visible motion.
actions.inferred_reason: Releases side locks to allow opening.

actions.observed_action: Pulls upwards on latch 4, but it binds and does not open.
actions.visual_evidence: Right index finger pulls upward on latch 4; latch flexes but fails to disengage from the rim.

stated_reason.text: Wait, this fourth latch is really stuck.

actions.inferred_reason: Internal vacuum or lid rim pressure is pinching the latch mechanism.

actions.observed_action: Presses left palm down onto center of lid while pulling latch 4 upward.
actions.instruction: Press down on the center of the lid to relieve tension, then pull latch 4 upward.
actions.visual_evidence: Left hand applies firm downward pressure to the center of the lid, compressing the silicone seal; right hand pulls latch 4, which swings free.

stated_reason.text: Pressing down on the lid to take tension off the clip... there, popped it open.

actions.inferred_reason: Downward pressure compresses the lid gasket and releases the undercut lip latch.

actions.observed_action: Flips open the silicone steam vent tab on the lid.
actions.instruction: Open the silicone steam vent on the lid.
actions.visual_evidence: Thumb flips the central circular silicone flap upward to expose the vent aperture.
actions.inferred_reason: Prevents pressure buildup inside the container while heating.
uncertainty: Actor did not state why the vent is being opened.

actions.observed_action: Lifts the lid completely off the rim and sets it back down loosely askew.
actions.instruction: Lift the lid off the rim and place it back on the container loosely unlatched.
actions.visual_evidence: Lid is lifted 5 cm above rim breaking contact, rotated approximately 15 degrees, and set back on top.

stated_reason.text: A sealed lid warps in the microwave, so we leave it resting loose.

actions.inferred_reason: Loose placement allows steam to escape while preventing food splatters in the microwave.

pending_questions.question: Why did you open the steam vent before reheating?
